prediction_text: Direction: the ship is LIVING — not sunk/wrecked — though she has been in hazard. Where/news: she is to be heard of to the westward/returning side (significators in the 7th, the western angle) and news comes very soon — the trine wanting but minutes puts news within days, on a day scale suited to an urgent ship question.
basis: Asc Cancer = ship's bulk; Moon lady Asc exalted Taurus 11th applying trine Sun/Mercury in 7th wanting minutes, near Jupiter; Saturn square Asc = peril testimony; Cauda in 9th and Part of Fortune disposed by Mars noted as secondary afflictions not outweighing exalted Moon.
